headword: {常任理事国|じょうにんりじこく}
gloss: permanent member (of the UN Security Council)

definitions.gloss: permanent member (of the UN Security Council)
definitions.explanation: One of the five countries with a permanent seat and a veto on the UN Security Council: the United States, the United Kingdom, France, Russia and China.

examples.japanese: {常任理事国|じょうにんりじこく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五|ご}→五：00697_go⟧か{国|こく}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{常任理事国|じょうにんりじこく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{拒否権|きょひけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The permanent members have a veto.
